name: omp-desktop
description: Desktop client for local Oh My Pi coding agents
author: OMP Desktop contributors

scripts.dev:server:watch: concurrently --kill-others --names protocol,client,server --prefix-colors yellow,blue,cyan "npm run watch:protocol" "npm run watch:client" "npm run dev:server:raw"
scripts.build:client:clean: npm run build:protocol:clean && npm run build:clean --workspace=@omp-desktop/client
scripts.build:server-deps: npm run build:client && npm run build:highlight
scripts.build:server-deps:clean: npm run build:client:clean && npm run build:highlight:clean
scripts.build:server: npm run build:server-deps && npm run build --workspace=@omp-desktop/server && npm run build --workspace=@omp-desktop/cli
scripts.build:server:clean: npm run build:server-deps:clean && npm run build:clean --workspace=@omp-desktop/server && npm run build:clean --workspace=@omp-desktop/cli
scripts.build:app-deps: npm run build:highlight && npm run build:client
scripts.build:app-deps:clean: npm run build:highlight:clean && npm run build:client:clean
scripts.typecheck:server: npm run typecheck --workspace=@omp-desktop/relay && npm run typecheck --workspace=@omp-desktop/protocol && npm run typecheck --workspace=@omp-desktop/client && npm run typecheck --workspace=@omp-desktop/server && npm run typecheck --workspace=@omp-desktop/cli
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build:app-deps:clean && npm run clean --workspace=@omp-desktop/app && cd packages/app && cross-env PASEO_WEB_PLATFORM=electron npx expo export --platform web && cd ../.. && npm run build --workspace=@omp-desktop/desktop --
